title: rename timeout to timeoutMs across modules
prompt: Rename the config option `timeout` (seconds) to `timeoutMs` (milliseconds) across src/config.mjs, src/client.mjs and src/cli.mjs. The default stays 30 seconds (30000 ms). The CLI flag `--timeout` becomes `--timeout-ms`. `describe()` must print `timeoutMs=30000 retries=2` for the defaults. Passing the old `timeout` option to createClient must throw an Error whose message mentions `timeoutMs`.
